entries.text: This scan found 30 issues across 30 elements on all 5 pages, and every one is critical or serious: 7 critical, 23 serious. Fix the social links in the shared footer first (src/Shell.jsx, the footer social links block at lines 30-32): they wrap hidden icons with no text, so a screen reader announces nothing for them, and one fix there clears all 15 elements at once. Next, the shared .muted text class, whose grey on white is too faint to read; changing that one colour covers 6 more elements sitewide.
